chapters.title: Chapter 1830
paragraphs: "Are you...also a Dimensional Champion?"
The question was asked so simply as Katelyn had a quizzical expression, Noah keeping his own expression calm as he didn't give anything away even though he was hearing this term for the first time.
But his silence could be mistaken for an answer as he gazed at Katelyn while asking his own question.
"What would make you think I was a Dimensional Champion?"
Yes.
What did this title actually mean, and how was it different from a Dimensional Royalty?!
Katelyn's eyes raised at such a question as she pondered briefly before she replied, at the same time recalling all the power left behind where Xian and Dion just fell.

"Existences with tight connections to Dimensions who aren't imposed with the same restrictions. The Dimensions running alongside Reality are extremely old and powerful as the beings within are even more so, and yet you do not see any Dimensional beings running around in the vast Realities."

"All Dimensionally bound existence cannot freely step into the vast Realities. With those who can being unique as they had to have a form of astounding authority from the Dimension...or others in a unique situation like me."
Noah's eyes shone with luminous lights at these words.

Katelyn was the daughter of a Dimensional Royalty and Alpha Strata LEGEND as she shared Bloodlines of both the vast Realities and Dimensions. While Noah...had attained his Dimensional connection through his System and then eventually Lavalliere with her Absolute Dream Authority that went to birth the Infinite Dream Physique!
His form buzzed with power as he was thinking, Katelyn waiting for his answer as he only smiled after a while and replied.
"I can't say anything about me being a Dimensional Champion, but I can answer your question that we agreed upon for the death of the little Aether beast."

Noah said this as he looked at the streaks of golden crimson true blood that were all that remained of a powerful Olden Emperor that had granted him a Supreme Olden Bloodline of the Aether Bourne Crocodile.

"Just like you have a connection with the Mirror Dimension through your own means, I gained a connection with the Dream Dimension with a Physique. Though, I don't seem to be nearly as powerful with the Essence of this Dimension compared to you- nor as special as I don't have existences chasing after my body so far."

Katelyn was following his words with focus as her calm eyes gradually became covered by a silvery light towards the end when she was reminded of why two Primogenial LEGENDS had just tried to attack her!

She let out a sigh as if she was woken up, looking at Noah whom she was curious about as unlike others- he didn't look at her with the repulsive gaze that she was used to from all men. She attributed this reason to him having already attained a Dimensional Physique as his means seemed immensely interesting, but she still had to continue moving at this moment as she nodded towards Noah and began floating away from the Dragon Phoenix's scaly head.
Her other body had turned into a streak of light to fuse with her as she released vibrant authority, Noah remaining situated upon Andur as he still voiced out towards her.
"You're going to leave just like that?"

He spoke while silently admiring the visage of this Dimensional Royalty who didn't even turn back as she turned to gaze up at the vibrant and cold chains of Reality arcing towards the glacial seas above.
"Just like you have your destiny, my own destiny also has a path I need to follow for me to achieve what I want. There is also Genevieve to take of....It is dangerous, but I shall do it nonetheless."
WAA!
Her words were filled with variance as she spoke, Mirror Essence buzzing around her as Noah wouldn't let her leave this easily!
So he cast out a net as he replied with a knowing nod.
"The <WELCOME> of the Grotto Nacres, did you find that here too?"
Noah spoke as he gazed at the golden dome he didn't feel any opportunities in as he guessed Katelyn must have somehow already gotten it!
Slight surprise covered Katelyn's eyes as she focused back on Noah briefly.
"Yes."
The surprised eyes of this Dimensional Royalty turned somber soon after as she gazed up in the distant glacial seas where the Essence of the Niflheim Dimension was getting thicker and even colder.
"It's giving me extremely dangerous waves of destiny when I think about it and what lies ahead."
She had the same premonition of danger as Noah- whatever lay ahead of them being something dreadful to even cause beings like them to move with care!
"Then...since we must take care of Genevieve and know of the dangers to come ahead, why don't we move together for now? Genevieve will be coming for me soon enough anyways..."
Noah had cast out a net as he began to pull it in at this moment.
Katelyn turned back towards him as she only saw his confident smile, her curiosity towards the mysteries he held still keeping her on the hook as she actually began to ponder.

"I've got a ride here and still have questions about Dimensions I wish to ask you, and I'll also answer any...viable questions that you have as well. You can also affirm with your destiny, but I'm sure I will not be anything close to a hindrance towards your goals."

Noah patted the shimmering golden purple scales of the Dragon Phoenix below him who shuddered, the Dimensional Royalty before his eyes becoming covered by a golden light as a myriad of silver gold lotuses began to bloom around her body- giving off immense waves of destiny as seemed to be looking for something!
She came out of her trance soon after as the lotuses faded, and she actually nodded her head as she floated back towards the draconic head where Noah sat calmly.

Her eyes were staring up towards the glacial cold seas that led to the unknown, the visage of Noah beside her placing his hands on the vibrant scales of the beast they were on as flourishing Dimensional Essence surged and wrapped around it.
HUUM!

With a sandy golden glow, the restrictions loosened in the surroundings as a flaming Dragon Phoenix carrying two beings moved towards the Chains of Reality arching upwards- Noah beginning his ascension towards the depths of the Grotto Sanctum that would reveal many things as this time, he had a beauty by his side!

chapters.title: Chapter 1831
paragraphs: While Noah began his ascension deeper into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, other beings also reached the first floating landmass as the True geniuses overcame the trials and also moved forward.

Across the outer ring where the Chains of Reality leading to the first Land masses were located, the chains leading from them all seemed to be pulled up from a single central region, showing that when one ascended even further- the geniuses that had been exploring and meeting opportunities separately would soon be able to meet!
The Scions of different Lineages of the Main Reality.
The hidden geniuses that others didn't even comprehend the power of!
And...whatever lay waiting in this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
In the Dimensional Holy Land.

Surges of multicolored Essence wrapped around Noah's main body that was seated on the Throne, his eyes fluttering as his eyelids began to open heavily as if they were golden gates that held behind them splendrous grandeur.
WAA!
A burst of light bloomed from his eyes opening as he rose from slumber, the third Infinite Dream ending as over 10,000 new Realities were assimilated into the Infinite Reality!
This included 2 unique Realities that were currently forming into their own domains the size of hundreds of Cosmos in a region of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.

But Noah's attention wasn't so much on this as it was on the other gains of the Infinite Dream, with the number of True Stars of Conquest exceeding 5,000 once more as yet another bold action could be taken.
While just waking up from slumber, Noah's first action was a domineering one.
"Take the Dictum Emperor to TABOO."
HUUM!
The incandescent light of Thousands of True Stars of Conquest flashed as they began budding to form a new Seed of TABOO!

At the same time, Noah breathed out while checking the vibrant state of his body that was being packed with essence constantly, the Infinite Reality Passages continuing to nourish him as even though his Aspects of Existence couldn't take any more essence- all of it was being stored in Noah's body!
Until he affirmed that he truly couldn't exceed the limitations anymore, this essence would continue building up as even now- he was looking at new means of Empowerment.

He could Trippe Empower his Aspects of Existence and a few more things as there were enough residual True Stars of Conquest to do so- the added Prime Realities and unique Realities each adding multiple True Stars of Conquest compared to normal Emerging Realities as Noah had hundreds to spare even now.
He waited for the most opportune time to do this, with Jim not knowing exactly when this time would be as only time would tell!

But while he waited for this time to come and a new Seed of TABOO was budding, there were also changes occurring to his Infinite Reality Passages now that the changes of the Infinite Reality were gradually stabilizing.
The Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi...would evolve based on the state of the Infinite Reality!
The Infinite Reality Passages and the rotation of one's origin that stemmed from this Modus Operandi would also undergo their own changes.

Noah rose from the throne he had been slumbering in this whole time as he gazed above him where vibrant massive stellar mountain-like Passages gushed essence onto him endlessly- these passages currently undergoing expansion as if they weren't massive already!
This wasn't all as their multicolored allure was beginning to dim while a sandy gold brightness began to permeate and brighten up along their massive mountain-like bodies.

The dense and massive sandy golden light of Dream Essence clustered around Noah's Infinite Reality Passages as the changes were computed and then quantified before Noah's eyes, the essence raining down from the radiant Reality Passages coming down with much more fervor!
<The Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi is undergoing changes as the Reality it is based on has achieved an unquantifiable state.>
<The Infinite Reality Passages birthed by the method of operation of the Gorumandizing Dimensional Reality have been heavily influenced by the essence of the Dream Dimension.>
HUUM!

Golden Essence burst and coiled like draconic snakes across the 50 Infinite Reality Passages, causing the 'skies' above the Dimensional Holy Land to be painted with utmost splendor as any beings might fall to their knees if they were to see it!
Yet Noah gazed at it all with a profound gaze of elation as this was what his soul looked for the most.
The sense of wonder at finding and unlocking unimaginable things!
The glory of opening paths and truths others could only dream of!
Everything something like this happened, Noah felt a sense of intoxication he couldn't even fully explain!
<The Infinite Reality Passages have undergone a significant expansion as each one now grants the Generation of 30,000 Units of The Essence of Reality per second.>
<The feature of Empyral Mitahara has been born.>
WAA!
Like a bolt of lightning, Noah's sight was illuminated by light as everything stopped!
Everything had to stop.
This was because the word <Empyral> had appeared on a feature...such a word holding too many meanings as it was reaching towards power that many LEGENDS were trying their best to grasp.
<Empyral Mitahara>.
Mitahara was a unique word that held many meanings, with some describing it as a habit of moderation or consumption of nourishment and how this came to affect one's Aspects of Existence!
It was a practice that promoted health, vitality, and strength!

<Empyral Mitahara>:: A heavy concept to grasp one's hands on as its activation allows for the Infinite Reality Passages to draw upon all of the essence it utilizes for nourishment and then add spicules of the essence of the Natural Laws of Reality into it to achieve the effect of nourishing a selected Bone, Musculature, or Organ to begin transforming into the higher stage of Empyral. The culminated essence requires passing through an established resonance of the Aspects of Existence as it costs 2 Million Units of the Essence of Reality to activate and maintain every single second thereafter. The rate of forming Empyral Bones, Musculatures, or Organs with this method is far faster than the natural nourishment of one's Aspects of Existence...
A ridiculous balance-breaking ability appeared...one that also had a ridiculous cost to use as it would heavily affect Noah's generation of the Essence of Reality if he kept it active!

chapters.title: Chapter 1832
paragraphs: <Empyral Mitahara>.

A feature that would cost Noah 2 Million Units of the Essence of Reality every single second to keep active, with his current generation being 1.5 Million Units per second as Noah couldn't even cast and keep this ability active!
But it was a terrifying one to say to the least, and as always...Noah was still hindered from usage due to his Realm.
He required resonated Aspects of Existence to do so, and he would only achieve this when forming his Reality.
At this point in time, everything was telling him to break through.
That he had reached the ultimate foundation in the stage of the Firmaments of Ascendancy as he could let go of any possibilities hereafter apart from the single one of advancement!
His Infinite Reality Passages that granted tremendous nourishment every single second and bathed his Aspects of Existence didn't change this.
Utilizing <Reality Assimilator> or receiving the portions of souls from countless vassals didn't change this!
"Is this really it?"

Noah raised his hands as he saw the stellar light vibrating within them, his skin constantly pulsing with waves of power as the Infinite Reality Passages above him continued to change and elevate themselves.
At such a juncture, Noah stared at his chest where Lavalliere should have been bound as he spoke absentmindedly.
"Can the Absolute Dream Authority make it possible? Can enough uses be built up to aid in exceeding absolute limits?"
Absolute Dream Authority.
What made the Infinite Dream Physique and many other things possible through Lavalliere's uses!
<...The are many things across these Realities and 9 Dimensions, but absolutes are just that.>

<I cannot calculate the number of Uses required for something such as that to be achieved as it is not just a matter of turning Dream into Reality- with your goal being something that is not achievable even in Dreams.>
WAA!
Yes.
Absolute Dream Authority had Dream in its name as it was something stemming from the peaks of authority from the Dream Dimension, and what Noah wanted to do was unachievable even in his dreams!

His stellar eyes shone luminously as his will surged with power and tyranny, rising from his throne entirely as he floated in the air and overlooked the Dimensional Holy Land while watching the next set of prompts of the elevation of the Infinite Runic Ecriture of Modus Operandi and the Infinite Reality Passages finish
<Due to the Reality your Modus Operandi is based on and the Primogenial Casuistic Origin, the pathway to the Paramount Ancient Reality [Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality] has been opened.>

When Noah had first achieved his Primogenial Casuistic Origin by breaking his Limits, he was shown the prompt that there was a high chance of attaining a <Paramount Ancient Reality> of the current Era!
With the advancement of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that Noah based the method of operation for his Reality...he could now confidently attain a <Paramount Kainos Dimensional Reality>.
Everything so far was just so sweetly pulling him towards forming his Reality as soon as possible, with the doors opening up behind it being utterly astounding.
Stellar cosmos swirled in his eyes as he remained steadfast, gazing at the last prompt that landed before his eyes.
<The Effects of all other features of the Infinite Reality Passages experience an elevation to their effects.>
BZZZT!

The Infinite Reality Passages above Noah released their final incandescent radiance as they were surrounded by dense sandy gold allure in their stellar makeup, the vibrant multicolored essences surging across them and showering onto Noah's body causing an absolutely fantastic scene to play out!
But in some of the Reality Passages where skills were being nourished in their depths, blinding rays of light surged and wrapped around the manifestation of these skills!

Noah gazed at this scene with twinkling eyes as it seemed that REIFIED skills would soon be coming to fruition, this elevation of the Infinite Reality Passages making the advancement of some finish up much quicker.

LEGENDS could gradually form reified skills with their essence as Noah's Mana and other resources that were refined a few times now would almost make it possible to utilize Quasi-Reified abilities, but those fostered and strengthened in the Infinite Reality Passages would be a stage above all others as Noah patiently waited for their results soon!
"As this occurs..."
He was feeling somewhat melancholic after the many repeated failures to exceed already exceeded Limits, and he felt like seeing someone that he knew would soothe his heart.

His Main Body became wrapped by a spatial light as the Infinite Reality Passages remained suspended up above, his True Sanguine Clones remaining with their tasks in the Dimensional Holy Land taking on its authority and Nourishment as his main body disappeared.
He crossed many layers of space as within moments, his stellar form and all of its tremendous glory reached a new location.
In the expanded lands of the old blue planet.

Vibrantly milky white trees holding ripe Primordial Apples could be seen stretching out in neat rows in one direction as multicolored trees holding Mythical Fruits of Life could be seen in another direction!

Other vibrant Sacred Herbs were stretched throughout as at the center was a vibrant clearing filled with surging liquefied seas of essence, a small floating golden castle being seen with golden steps leading down to fields of farms filled with lush and glittering soil.

Currently, the figure of a woman that didn't seem older than in her 30s could be seen breathing out a sigh of happiness as she had just finished planting another seed for the new sacred herbs that were unlocked, a young boy that looked a bit over 10 floating to bring her a cup of a milky gold drink as these two were none other than Little Henry and his Grandmother- Amelia Osmont!

The vibrant Essence and boosts from Noah's Lineage had made Mother Amelia seemingly revert in years as she gave off a vibrant air, Noah smiling as he saw them while Little Henry was the first to turn towards his teleporting figure.
"Father!"

The young boy born just days ago yet looking 10 years old smiled cutely, with one never thinking his clone was currently outside the vast Realities moving with Hyperion, the Emperor Penguin, Natalya, and many others in order to hunt down dwellings of powerful Primordial Beasts!
Noah patted the cerulean and black hair of his son as his mother turned towards him with a loving smile and eyes that seemed to see everything.
"What's gotten my Little Tyrant down?"
With profound warmth, Noah smiled as his stellar form faded, dashing human skin covering him as he became indistinguishable from any normal human being!

Stellar cosmos swirled in his eyes as he remained steadfast, gazing at the last prompt that landed before his eyes.
<The Effects of all other features of the Infinite Reality Passages experience an elevation to their effects.>
BZZZT!

The Infinite Reality Passages above Noah released their final incandescent radiance as they were surrounded by dense sandy gold allure in their stellar makeup, the vibrant multicolored essences surging across them and showering onto Noah's body causing an absolutely fantastic scene to play out!
But in some of the Reality Passages where skills were being nourished in their depths, blinding rays of light surged and wrapped around the manifestation of these skills!

Noah gazed at this scene with twinkling eyes as it seemed that REIFIED skills would soon be coming to fruition, this elevation of the Infinite Reality Passages making the advancement of some finish up much quicker.

LEGENDS could gradually form reified skills with their essence as Noah's Mana and other resources that were refined a few times now would almost make it possible to utilize Quasi-Reified abilities, but those fostered and strengthened in the Infinite Reality Passages would be a stage above all others as Noah patiently waited for their results soon!
"As this occurs..."
He was feeling somewhat melancholic after the many repeated failures to exceed already exceeded Limits, and he felt like seeing someone that he knew would soothe his heart.

His Main Body became wrapped by a spatial light as the Infinite Reality Passages remained suspended up above, his True Sanguine Clones remaining with their tasks in the Dimensional Holy Land taking on its authority and Nourishment as his main body disappeared.
He crossed many layers of space as within moments, his stellar form and all of its tremendous glory reached a new location.
In the expanded lands of the old blue planet.

Vibrantly milky white trees holding ripe Primordial Apples could be seen stretching out in neat rows in one direction as multicolored trees holding Mythical Fruits of Life could be seen in another direction!

Other vibrant Sacred Herbs were stretched throughout as at the center was a vibrant clearing filled with surging liquefied seas of essence, a small floating golden castle being seen with golden steps leading down to fields of farms filled with lush and glittering soil.

Currently, the figure of a woman that didn't seem older than in her 30s could be seen breathing out a sigh of happiness as she had just finished planting another seed for the new sacred herbs that were unlocked, a young boy that looked a bit over 10 floating to bring her a cup of a milky gold drink as these two were none other than Little Henry and his Grandmother- Amelia Osmont!

The vibrant Essence and boosts from Noah's Lineage had made Mother Amelia seemingly revert in years as she gave off a vibrant air, Noah smiling as he saw them while Little Henry was the first to turn towards his teleporting figure.
"Father!"

The young boy born just days ago yet looking 10 years old smiled cutely, with one never thinking his clone was currently outside the vast Realities moving with Hyperion, the Emperor Penguin, Natalya, and many others in order to hunt down dwellings of powerful Primordial Beasts!
Noah patted the cerulean and black hair of his son as his mother turned towards him with a loving smile and eyes that seemed to see everything.
"What's gotten my Little Tyrant down?"
With profound warmth, Noah smiled as his stellar form faded, dashing human skin covering him as he became indistinguishable from any normal human being!

chapters.title: Chapter 1833
paragraphs: "Does it seem like I'm down?"
Noah spoke with a smile as he gave a hug to his mom and patted Little Henry's head, looking at the fields of Sacred Herbs around this area and the floating golden castle in the distance.

Noah had given his family free rein to request things from the Infinite Reality as the one thing his mother loved to do was farm and watch the process of plants blooming and harvesting- with her Edicts naturally forming in this direction as the things she planted could even produce unique effects!

Her dark hair shone with brilliance as she had known a single white dress, her eyes already beginning to buzz with Dimensional Essence as the effect of Interlinked Royal Lineage expressed itself on her and Little Henry.
"A mother can always tell when something is worrying their son. Come, tell me what happened."
Mother Amelia patted the glimmering earth below as Noah came to sit beside her, Little Henry grabbing extra drinks for them happily as Noah spoke lightly while gazing into the fields around them.

"I've crossed a barrier of limitation and reached an uncrossable absolute limitation, with my foundation not being capable of being built up any further as everything is telling me that I've reached everything I can reach in this stage...and that I should proceed forward. But my heart isn't content. I still feel like there should be a possibility...but I just cannot grasp it."

Noah's voice buzzed out as he explained his current situation to his mother in simple terms, even going forward to explain and infuse her with streams of memories about Aspects of Existence and the Limits he had already exceeded!

His mother nodded his head in understanding while Little Henry obediently listened on the side, not shocked in the very least to hear that his father had broken the Limitations of all Aspects of his Existence as he now wanted to break past even this.
"Limitations, TABOO concepts, Destiny...I may not know much in all these compared to you, but I do know my son."
Mother Amelia began to speak thoughtfully as she organized all her thoughts and continued.
"You've had many enemies before, but do you know who your greatest enemy has always been?"
"Mmm, myself?" Noah smiled happily as he laid his head on his mother's shoulder.

"Cheeky boy...yes. Other people can target you or call you names, other people can disappoint you, other people can tell you how things should be done...and many more things. But it all comes down to what you decided to do in the end."
"This Limitation you're talking about, who decided that it was an absolute limitation?"
BZZZT!
The surroundings began to buzz as Mother Amelia's words vibrated with a sense of tyranny!

"This progression of Cosmic Filament to Reality and its steps, who decided them? Must you follow the path that is established by others? Even if you say that this is what is allowable by the bounds of Reality...have you not been doing many Reality altering things so far? Can you not forge your own path amidst all this?"
The eyes of Mother Amelia were releasing a profound light as she spoke, her hand stroking Noah's head as his own eyes began to release a terrific light!

"I also remember how you always tried to do everything yourself even back then. School, work...you didn't like depending on others as you had been disappointed too many times. We can blame your father for many of the reasons behind that but...this can also be a limitation that you place on yourself. You don't always have to put everything on your shoulders, and you also don't need to only depend on yourself when facing a problem."
"So don't always try to do everything alone. Work is always made easy when you have others helping you out...and you have countless existences in this Infinite Reality. Don't count all of them out."
WAA!
Noah's eyes shone luminously as his destiny buzzed at his Mother's words!
The buzzing of Karma and Fate also rose as countless resplendent strings erupted from him...his very soul buzzing as destiny seemed to have caught onto something after his mother's words!
He didn't fully know what it was yet as going from the words of his mom, Noah's head rose up as his hands pulled out a golden book.
Seas of destiny began to swirl around him as his eyes became lost in this grandeur, with his will wanting to grasp whatever had appeared before either escaped from his fingers.
Mother Amelia saw this as she smiled and nodded towards Little Henry, the two of them rising up and moving to another row of the vibrant soil as they allowed Noah to work on his epiphany in peace.

Seas of destiny began to rise around Noah as he tried to piece together what there was that could help him, changes continuing to bloom around this area and even further away as in the Dimensional Holy Land, his True Sanguine Clones rose their eyes to the Infinite Reality Passages above that were buzzing with even more activity!

Specifically, it was one Infinite Reality Passage that was currently the most active, a crimson red fiery light roaring out at its very center as this was the Passage that held the <Ascendant Reality Fireball> within it.
HOONG!
The Infinite Reality Passage released tumultuous crimson red light as if it was undergoing a volcanic eruption, its center releasing a vibrant light of glory as within Noah's mind, a prompt rose!
<Ascendant Reality Fireball had undergone successful REIFICATION.>
The first skill to be placed in an Infinite Reality Passage forged the way forward and advanced as at the center of the first Reality Passage, an incandescent form began to unveil itself.

Like a butterfly breaking out of its cocoon, a visage of a crimson stellar existence that was seemingly clumped up into a fiery ball unfurled, its hands rising out gloriously as magisterial fiery stellar wings erupted behind it!

The radiant head of this existence rose up next as tendrils of crimson gold hair flowed down to its shoulders, and a crown made of stellar flames domineeringly burned above this head that showed an existence with an unreasonable sense of beauty and wonder open its eyes!
HUUUM!

Behind the fiery stellar wings of this shocking visage, a circular row of multicolored stellar balls of flames bloomed- with more and more circular rows coming to fruition soon after as each ball of flames shone with a terrifying radiance that could burn a beginner LEGEND to a crisp!

chapters.title: Chapter 1834
paragraphs: In one of the dazzling Infinite Reality Passages, the visage of a titanic stellar being formed from flames could be seen as a radiant crown of flames shone brightly above her, her radiant crimson red stellar wings having rows of circular balls of Flames that seemed like endlessly burning condensed Realities!
She had unfurled her hands, wings, and feet as if she was a newborn- her eyes opening soon after as they rained down shocking brilliance and power.

Her gaze landed on none other than Noah below her as the eyes of this blank will sparkled- a mischievous smile shockingly appearing on her eyes and mouth as she used one of her stellar crimson hands to wave towards Noah below!
Her entire visage screamed of TABOO and power as this...was the REIFIED Ascendant Reality Fireball.
HUUM!

Essence flooded out all around as the Infinite Reality Passage continued to nourish her- the boosts of power being something that would continue to be elevated in the future as the current power of the Ascendant Reality Fireball...
<...It is still in the process of being computed and quantified, Master.>
Was not even ready to be revealed as the process of REIFICATION must have produced shocking results!

REIFICATION! Legends had to spend time and effort to make their abilities achieve this state after bathing them with the resonated essence of their Primogenial Strata and the nourishment from their Reality Passages.

Geniuses in the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy could unique achieve something halfway there as some were capable enough to form Quasi-REIFIED abilities- but Noah bypassed all of this with Tyrannical Reifier to attain a stupendous Reified Ability that would even continue to be enhanced overtime!

Noah nodded at this level of wonder as he waited for the results, his connected Will feeling his Main Body dance around with the tumultuous weaving of destiny after hearing his mother's words- where he actually picked up a possible path that could grant him the results he sought!
First was the perception of how he looked at everything.
When he reached the 'upper limits' of the Aspects of Existence, what made him agree that they were truly the upper limits that couldn't be exceeded anymore?
Just because his Origin, Soul, and Body didn't have the capability to expand any further in this stage- must that be the Reality?!
The other point that his mom had made...was that he wasn't alone.
He had countless existences in the Infinite Reality under him, and when his destiny had caught onto to this- Karma and Fate followed as there actually seemed to be something in this direction!

It seemed that there was someone or multiple of his vassals who could actually contribute in helping him in his research to exceed already exceeded Limits, and he had been using Destiny to find out exactly who this would involve as this was taking some time.
And since it was taking time...Noah once more smiled as he put the word of relying on others into practice- and thus, he spoke to the Infinite Reality!
"Are there any exceptional beings that have risen recently in the Infinite Reality? Any that stand above the rest and have something unique?"
WAA!
Silent waves of destiny echoed out as the Infinite Reality replied soon after.

<Apart from the Child of Destiny bourne from Master, there are 193 others that can be considered unique as their Aspects of Existence, Destiny, Fate, or other conceptual parts of themselves either underwent a mutation or veered from the norm during Upgrades of the Infinite Reality or through unique means.>
"Oh?"

Noah's brows rose at this as he breathed out and focused on his connection with the Infinite Reality, his will latching onto it as he prepared to connect fully to understand and receive information rapidly.
<Yes. The most unique ones are the Oathkeeper, Dr. Hall, the Atlantean Emperor...>
The Infinite Reality listed many names as Noah connected to it to deeply understand the inhabitants of his Lands, trying to see which among them could actually contribute to his research!
p"The Oathkeeper?"
Noah remembered the Protector that became his Vassal what seemed like forever ago when it wasn't even too long.
<Yes, he has been steadily raising the Primordial Disc that complemented RUINATION. Though it is still in the air if he can raise this Relic to come even close to RUINATION.>
"Mmm, and this...Dr. Hall?"

<Adrian Hall. A native of the Blue Planet who managed to very quickly achieve a unique Quasi-TABOO Nomological Edict during the changes occurring due to the recent elevation to a Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality...>
Waves of destiny flowed silently as Noah's mind delved and focused on the information of beings brought up before his eyes, where he wouldn't have to even wait too long to find what he wanted!
Destiny was weaving in a tumultuous manner as its influence spread far and wide.

In the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, it had begun to erupt and turn wild as the Unnamed Kainos Emperor attempted shocking things, while in the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum...a portion of the genius Emperors of this Age were all pulled with the weaving of destiny towards one location.

They all gathered as each one shone with their own astounding destiny, the depths of a cold and dreary domain that pulled all of them in holding shocking mysteries as the influence of the Niflheim Dimension was merely just that!
On one of the Chains of Reality that led into the endless unknown.
The further up one moved across the deathly cold seas, the more the surroundings became heavier as they were currently coagulating into solid glacial ice that made it extremely hard to move.

Yet a single mount was tearing across the condensing states of matter with vibrant fervor as its Master provided its body with waves of Dimensional Essence that also surged onto the Chain of Reality below, causing the restrictions around the areas it passed to be lifted as it moved with ease!

Atop this Dragon Phoenix that shone with golden purple scales and had vibrant winged flames of the same color, the pristine figures of a man and woman sat in front of the draconic horns at the very forefront of this being as the two of them seemed to be exceedingly beautiful Celestial gracing the common world with their presence.
The silver white hair on Katelyn shone with light as while they began to edge upwards towards the unknown, she finally paid attention to the genius below her.
"Who is this that you have subjugated under your authority?"
A question that caused Noah to smile as he didn't reply, wondering the thoughts of this Dimensional Royalty when it came to him taking a Pure-Blooded Primordial as someone to serve him!

chapters.title: Chapter 1835
paragraphs: Noah didn't reply to Katelyn's question as he patted the scales of the Dragon Phoenix who replied with a low voice.
"...I am Andur, Young Miss. From the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality."
"Oh." Katelyn nodded simply as if this didn't interest her all that much!
This was a young Genius prominent from the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage, and yet Katelyn had shown a distant reply the moment the Main Reality was mentioned.

The so called geniuses from this vast domain...she didn't have a greatly favorable impression of them due to past events as this was part of the reason she didn't even bat an eye when she saw Noah standing above this Dragon Phoenix.
Her eyes instead landed on the crown above Andur that read <VAS> as she raised her eyes towards the calm figure of Noah once more!
"You putting another Emperor under you directly alters their authority?"
"Mmm." Noah gave a light nod as he gazed at the shimmering crown above Andur.
"The Emperors that fall under my heel shall be distinguished as my VASSALS. In the future, they should be far stronger than many Candidate Emperors..."
Noah spoke of a grand future as Katelyn's eyes flashed, her thoughts kept to herself as she actually thought of this carefully!
BZZZT!

The seas around them gradually turned entirely frozen as Andur's huge body now decimated the glaciers they passed while forging forward, Noah's Dimensional essence and the Essence of Reality continuing to flow out of him unceasingly as this didn't pass Katelyn's eyes.

"You've mentioned talking about secrets, but I'm still curious about your usage of essence right now. We've been ascending upwards for a significant period of time now as Dimensional Essence and Essence of Reality continued to be produced by you without so much as a worry...how unique is your Dream Physique to be able to do this."
"Oh?" Noah stopped gazing up ahead as he turned to the young woman beside him, his hand pointing up as he spoke while a single massive Infinite Reality Passage appeared!
"We'll continue to trade secrets then. I have larger reserves of Essence and generate much more of it freely due to my Reality Passages. I'm sure you have your own unique Reality Passages?"
Noah tried to probe the power of this Dimensional Royalty before him who gazed at his massive Infinite Reality Passage with eyes of intense focus.

She replied to him in passing while the illusion of 100, and then 200, and then 300 silvery Reality Passages flashed above Katelyn in the cold glacial seas above- this illusion of Passages about to add another 100 as it didn't even seem like she had shown all of them!
"Yes. But mine...aren't truly my own. They also carry a trace of inheritance from the Mirror Dimension that I did not ask for...."
She spoke slowly and with a sigh as the illusion of her Reality Passages faded.
Noah watched this scene closely as his will worked fast, trying to attain as much information about this being before him as he asked calmly.
"Can you tell me about the Mirror Dimension? The powers and Royalties within that aren't even allowed into the vast Realities?"

While ascending the fold yet vibrant Chain of Reality, the Unnamed Kainos Emperor tried to unveil the mystery of a Dimensional Royalty while the latter being also fed her curiosity about the anomaly that had stepped into the Royal Human Bloodline, the experience being unique and different as it wasn't something that was possible for her before!

They weren't the only ones climbing across similar Chains of Reality as far away from them, the hidden figure of Genevieve who held an entirely different form at this moment also ascended upwards- her body surrounded by surging waves of TABOO essence as shockingly, her face actually carried a trace of amazement and shock at this moment.

This was because the areas of increasingly heavy restrictions...didn't seem to pose much of an effect on her as she went up, and it instead even caused her body to begin bubbling with a profound power!

She had devoured multiple geniuses while in different forms as the number of TABOO Edicts under her belt had already reached over 30, but this wasn't the reason why restrictions that were imposed on all other beings seemed to be coming looser as she climbed up.
It was all in her...
"Blood..."
WAA!
She echoed these words out with shock and disbelief as she stared at the glacial seas around her, where even she had no idea what lay up ahead! But the sheer fact that she felt unfettered...
BOOM!
Made her move upwards explosively as she shot out with speeds many others beings entering this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum wouldn't be able to match!

Out of all the beings that just recently entered this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, she was the only one to experience this shocking change as when she thought about what might possibly be up ahead, her eyes couldn't help but release a shocking radiance.

She went up at a shocking pace, but other distinguished geniuses were still forging ahead at the same pace with those even more monstrous actually being faster as they all followed the tout strings of destiny.
They brought all means possible to bypass the forming glaciers in increasingly dreadful seas- the Essence of the Niflheim Dimension becoming dense and denser as the further in one went.
Past the snaking Chains of Reality, a vast and exceedingly vast landmass of frozen death and wonder lay.

Chains of Reality snaked over and sunk into the cold earth of this landmass as dense gray mist was covering the sight of anyone that gazed further in- the contents of everything held within being covered as one could mainly feel the oppressive and restrictive laws around them!

Wondrously, the glacial sea ended the moment one finished ascending the snaking Chains of Reality as they came upon the open and misty skies of this cold landmass that seemed to be converging all the Chains towards a central location.

At this moment, there were less than a dozen figures that came from different directions of floating land masses as they managed to break past the glacial sea layer and converge in this new region with a few second differences from each other.

One of these beings had glimmering wings shining on her legs and even more vibrant wings on her back, her eyes vibrating with luminous light as they seemed capable of piercing across the dense mist ahead!
Another was a shocked Disaster Remanant whose Blood continued to boil with even more fervor as she could feel seas of golden destiny unexpectedly open up before her.
Another was a vibrant Dragon Phoenix mount that carried two shocking beings, and there was uniquely another party of two that arrived around the same time.
A pair of a young man and woman that one wouldn't expect to be the types of beings to make it this far and this quickly- it was Ezekiel and Nefertiti!

sentences.text: Noah didn't reply to Katelyn's question as he patted the scales of the Dragon Phoenix who replied with a low voice.
"...I am Andur, Young Miss.
From the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality."
"Oh." Katelyn nodded simply as if this didn't interest her all that much!
This was a young Genius prominent from the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage, and yet Katelyn had shown a distant reply the moment the Main Reality was mentioned.

The so called geniuses from this vast domain...she didn't have a greatly favorable impression of them due to past events as this was part of the reason she didn't even bat an eye when she saw Noah standing above this Dragon Phoenix.
Her eyes instead landed on the crown above Andur that read <VAS> as she raised her eyes towards the calm figure of Noah once more!
"You putting another Emperor under you directly alters their authority?"
"Mmm." Noah gave a light nod as he gazed at the shimmering crown above Andur.
"The Emperors that fall under my heel shall be distinguished as my VASSALS.
In the future, they should be far stronger than many Candidate Emperors..."
Noah spoke of a grand future as Katelyn's eyes flashed, her thoughts kept to herself as she actually thought of this carefully!
BZZZT!

The seas around them gradually turned entirely frozen as Andur's huge body now decimated the glaciers they passed while forging forward, Noah's Dimensional essence and the Essence of Reality continuing to flow out of him unceasingly as this didn't pass Katelyn's eyes.
"You've mentioned talking about secrets, but I'm still curious about your usage of essence right now.

We've been ascending upwards for a significant period of time now as Dimensional Essence and Essence of Reality continued to be produced by you without so much as a worry...how unique is your Dream Physique to be able to do this."
"Oh?" Noah stopped gazing up ahead as he turned to the young woman beside him, his hand pointing up as he spoke while a single massive Infinite Reality Passage appeared!
"We'll continue to trade secrets then.
I have larger reserves of Essence and generate much more of it freely due to my Reality Passages.
I'm sure you have your own unique Reality Passages?"
Noah tried to probe the power of this Dimensional Royalty before him who gazed at his massive Infinite Reality Passage with eyes of intense focus.

She replied to him in passing while the illusion of 100, and then 200, and then 300 silvery Reality Passages flashed above Katelyn in the cold glacial seas above- this illusion of Passages about to add another 100 as it didn't even seem like she had shown all of them!
"Yes.
But mine...aren't truly my own.
They also carry a trace of inheritance from the Mirror Dimension that I did not ask for...."
She spoke slowly and with a sigh as the illusion of her Reality Passages faded.
Noah watched this scene closely as his will worked fast, trying to attain as much information about this being before him as he asked calmly.
"Can you tell me about the Mirror Dimension?
The powers and Royalties within that aren't even allowed into the vast Realities?"

While ascending the fold yet vibrant Chain of Reality, the Unnamed Kainos Emperor tried to unveil the mystery of a Dimensional Royalty while the latter being also fed her curiosity about the anomaly that had stepped into the Royal Human Bloodline, the experience being unique and different as it wasn't something that was possible for her before!

They weren't the only ones climbing across similar Chains of Reality as far away from them, the hidden figure of Genevieve who held an entirely different form at this moment also ascended upwards- her body surrounded by surging waves of TABOO essence as shockingly, her face actually carried a trace of amazement and shock at this moment.

This was because the areas of increasingly heavy restrictions...didn't seem to pose much of an effect on her as she went up, and it instead even caused her body to begin bubbling with a profound power!

She had devoured multiple geniuses while in different forms as the number of TABOO Edicts under her belt had already reached over 30, but this wasn't the reason why restrictions that were imposed on all other beings seemed to be coming looser as she climbed up.
It was all in her...
"Blood..."
WAA!
She echoed these words out with shock and disbelief as she stared at the glacial seas around her, where even she had no idea what lay up ahead!
But the sheer fact that she felt unfettered...
BOOM!
Made her move upwards explosively as she shot out with speeds many others beings entering this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum wouldn't be able to match!

Out of all the beings that just recently entered this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, she was the only one to experience this shocking change as when she thought about what might possibly be up ahead, her eyes couldn't help but release a shocking radiance.

She went up at a shocking pace, but other distinguished geniuses were still forging ahead at the same pace with those even more monstrous actually being faster as they all followed the tout strings of destiny.
They brought all means possible to bypass the forming glaciers in increasingly dreadful seas- the Essence of the Niflheim Dimension becoming dense and denser as the further in one went.
Past the snaking Chains of Reality, a vast and exceedingly vast landmass of frozen death and wonder lay.

Chains of Reality snaked over and sunk into the cold earth of this landmass as dense gray mist was covering the sight of anyone that gazed further in- the contents of everything held within being covered as one could mainly feel the oppressive and restrictive laws around them!

chapters.title: Chapter 1836
paragraphs: The pull of destiny gathered many beings towards a land filled with heavy mist, where one wouldn't even be able to see or hear another if they were a few meters away.
The vision and hearing of all beings in the area...restricted! It was a wondrous result that came about through unfathomable means.

And given the heavy restrictions that only became more prevalent the deeper one went into this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, it meant one's will, hearing, and vision were limited to a few meters around them!
Those who had arrived in these vast lands first didn't know who or what else lay around them as they were displaced for an unknown number of miles.

After their entrance, others gradually made their way up with their own means as they arrived later, the other set of beings coming later including the vibrant astral existence known as Juliette- her Astral visage adorned with a red battle dress as her head danced with crimson flames.
Beside her was the figure of Helen who was panting as if she was out of breath, looking towards Juliette with frustration as she also gazed at the cold and misty land around them.
"Some of us aren't Chosen Emperors with ridiculous abilities...you could have at least slowed down a little!"

The two exceedingly beautiful women had met up even after the separation of the teleportation after their entrance, a smile densely arching on Juliette as above her crown, the ecritures of <FLAME EMPERO> shone brightly- meaning she had undoubtedly increased her authority on her way here.
"Who would have thought this Grotto Sanctum would actually be filled with a mystery? I'm curious who's bold enough to say <WELCOME> to the geniuses of the Primordials!"

Juliette was filled with battle intent and wonder as she moved at her own pace, Helen groaning as she followed behind this being that began to move deeper into the mist to explore what lay around them.

Miles away from their location, an existence that carried a glistening TABOO Techo Relic Rifle behind her back also broke past the glacial seas and stepped into this hand, her eyes careful and heavy as she reached for her weapon the moment she arrived.

Even further away from that location, a large group of Dragon Phoenixes rose together from a Chain of Reality as their whole group was surrounded by an incandescent light that withdrew into a single being at the very forefront.

His scales carried the vibrant colors of gold and white that were different from Andur, with an authority that was even more vibrant as around his solidified crown, the ecritures <EMPERO> shone brightly!
"Emperor Aegon...the restrictions continue getting even heavier. We won't be able to aid you at our full power..."
One of the Dragon Phoenixes in the back heaved a sigh as its scales creaked from the pressure, Aegon not turning his head back as he gazed at the misty and cold lands around them.

"We move forward. The so called Alexander King you all mentioned...the winds of Destiny tell me we shall find traces of him in these lands. If he truly killed Andur...he will be buried in these lands along with everyone else!"
WAA!
Arcs of flames and brutality shone from this being as more and more existences climbed up the heavy restrictions and made their way into the barren and cold misty lands!

In another region, the vibrant Young Emperor that also stemmed from the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline rose with his entourage- his shocking perception in Destiny and Fate allowing him to find those who supported him the quickest in the outer areas of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as with great effort, they arrived here.

This being was still in his humanoid form as a flaming golden robe adorned him, his solidified crown with a vibrant <EMPEROR> swirling above it being painted with a hue of gold as even before coming into this Unexplored Grotto Sanctum...this being had seen that not everything was as it seemed!
"Young Emperor...shall we proceed forward?"
,m One of his people with a tired expression asked, and the Young Emperor actually shook his head with a thoughtful expression as he replied with his gaze overlooking into the unknown.

"No. The veils surrounding us...will soon enough come down on their own as the truth will be laid bare to all. The Harbingers of Death who have reached out to the Niflheim Dimension and utilized its influence...we shall know them soon enough."
Dense waves of TABOO concepts of destiny, fate, and karma surrounded this being as he seemed to have multiple TABOO Edicts geared towards Destiny, Fate, and Karma!

Such insights allowed him to see many more things that others didn't as his party remained right where they were and didn't move any further, recovering their essence while bearing the heavy restrictions around them.
As time passed, more and more genius existences climbed up, some of them shining with shocking splendor as their Passage here meant they had attained the Grotto Nacres on the floating landmasses.
For the geniuses who were holding their foundation this whole time...some chose to become LEGENDS right after as they began to utilize the Grotto Nacres to elevate their Primogenial Strata!
The Will Bearer Trio of the Nine Sea.
Reality Ursidae whose bodies resonated with their surroundings.
The Child of the Trees with a cluster of glimmering Infinite Willow Trees.
A dazzling Limit Breaker from the Royal Humans of the Main Reality!
Other Leaders of Obsidian Adjudicator Legions!
Other groups of Will Bearers that were under the rule of renowned LEGENDS!
Many of the powerful existences gathered and stepped into the barren lands filled with coldness, death, and dense mist that covered their wills, hearing, and vision heavily!
Amidst all this, the visage of a young man wrapped in Dream Essence was thoughtful as he gazed into the mist ahead and around them.
Katelyn sat opposite him atop the skull of the Dragon Phoenix still, Golden lotuses of destiny blooming and breaking around her as her gaze hardened.
"Is it Destiny...or actually Calamity?"
Katelyn spoke softly as she looked ahead into the unknown.
Noah's eyes were also swirling with destiny as while The Dictum Emperor's Seed of TABOO neared completion, many more things were becoming clear to his eyes.

The Unexplored Grotto Sanctum had the attention of even Alpha Strata LEGENDS as it drew in many astounding geniuses- their very origins telling them that a shocking Destiny waited for them in this domain...so long as they survived the dangers.
A destiny that if they attained it, their path towards becoming a True Emperor would be paved with even more ease!
To be capable of spreading its influence on so many geniuses and drawing them in, this destiny had to have been tremendous in its effect and might.
To establish the true reality that it would aid one in the path to becoming a True Emperor...It was something that caused even Alpha Strata LEGENDS to oversee it!
But what if this astounding destiny...was not naturally formed?
What if it was something uniquely set up?!

chapters.title: Chapter 1837
paragraphs: What exactly drew so many genius existences who had been forging their foundations over too many years into this Grotto Sanctum?
The question would be answered soon enough, and Noah was understanding more of the weaving of Destiny around them as they had remained in the same location for the past hour.
The dense and stifling essence of the Niflheim Dimension was even more pervasive in this region, with one needing to protect themselves with the Essence of Reality and TABOO authority constantly!

Noah and Katelyn were gazing at everything atop the Dragon Phoenix, the Mirror Essence and Destiny around Katelyn bursting at this moment as she gazed at the skies above that were also filled with gray mist.
"It should be soon."
HUUM!
Essence began to coil and rumble.
Noah nodded his head as he felt it as well, his heart at ease as his will was focusing on multiple crucial things at this time!

One was discerning the events that were blooming within the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum, and the other was his main body seeking the path past absolute limitations in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
'It seems the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum will reveal itself first...'
The ringing of destiny buzzed in his mind as he also gazed above in the skies.
There- amidst abundant mist and restrictions that didn't allow one to see anything...a golden star began to shine!
At the same time, outside of the Domain Rift that led into the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum.
It had always been pulsating with a stellar purple blue luster as even after the first set of entrants went in, others could still continue to enter over time.
But at this moment, this reality sized Domain Rift instantly changed colors and became red, releasing a pulse of immense light!
HOONG!
A light that erupted out for a few light years before it began to recede into the Domain Rift that actually began to rapidly reduce in size and fold in on itself!
From four different directions, the Wills of Four Alpha Strata LEGENDS moved at this sudden change as this whole area was bathed with glory.

Before an instant could even pass, incandescent rivers of Reality had wrapped around the folding Rift- the massive visage of the Alpha Strata Astral LEGENDS being the quickest as innumerable branches of the Infinite Willow Tree sank into the bounds of the Domain Rift and held it in place next!
BZZZT!
The Rift buzzed with heavy Reality altering power, but its infolding was stopped as a unique power came to cover everything in the surroundings and held it in place.
The wills from different directions were heavy as the masses of Primogenial and a few Beta Strata LEGENDS in the surroundings clamored to observe the changes.
From the direction of the Alpha Strata Astral LEGEND, a booming voice echoed out.
"It was a scheme."

Changes bloomed outside of the Unexplored Grotto Sanctum as its Gateway nearly forcefully closed, but the changes inside were becoming even more profound as the gray mist that covered everything began to churn!
HOOONG!
Destiny was put in motion.

Whatever the reasons and machinations...they all came out in the open as the veil of mist began to tremble and seethe, gradually beginning to disappear in the regions near the Chains of Reality that led many beings here.
Gradually, the gazes of many went up as the changes seemed to be stemming from the skies.

The prominent geniuses that stemmed from Lineages of Pure-Blooded Bloodlines from the Main Reality and those outside of it gazed up as at an incredibly high point in the skies, they could see a blinding light of a golden 'star' beginning to shine!
Golden rays of austere light were raining down as the source of the veil disappearing stemmed from an extremely high point in the skies- a point that seemed light years away.
Yet its brightness could even be felt from here when it was unveiled as its Origins had to be shocking.

It was rays of golden light, but they gradually turned into waves of light that pierced the veils of mist, things in the immediate surroundings gradually becoming clear as the barren gray earth could be seen.
The waves of golden light weren't mere luminescence as they shockingly carried an informative essence that could be understood by all those it washed down on!

The information could be understood by any beings who could easily grasp essence, and it was displayed differently for Noah as his system showed a magisterial golden text box that carried fantastical words.
<The Heart of Destiny has begun to descend.>
WAA!
His eyes released rays of luminous light as beside him, Katelyn's body began to vibrate with Mirror Essence as she repeated the words she had interpreted, her eyes actually holding traces of shock!
"The Heart of Destiny!"

The Dimensional Royalty who couldn't be easily swayed actually held a hint of shock when she read the information cascading down, but the situation was rapidly changing as the restrictions of vision were gradually lifted in the surroundings- with one being able to see everything nearby with ease as the gray mist was shaken by the rays of golden light.
Barren Lands filled with dead vegetation could be seen, blue ice lining up the areas further inward as the gray mist was still being dissipated there- and at a much slower pace than that.
But with the lifting of the gray veil, those who had climbed up the Chains of Reality could begin to sew those that had managed to climb in this region!
Some time had passed since the first sets of beings appeared on these lands, but many more had arrived since then as the number of Primordials that had appeared here wasn't small.

Whether through relying on the power of others or spending their TABOO authority and Essence of Reality to withstand the restrictions, they slowly appeared here as the truly weak geniuses were all weeded out!
What remained were the strongest of the strong- the geniuses who had all formed TABOO Edicts and had astounding destinies!
The generation of Emperors who would reign in the future to come.
Now, these geniuses could gaze at each other once more as when the surroundings cleared, many of their eyes lit up as they saw those they knew of or were familiar with.
The dazzling figure of Akaris adorned with pairs of wings on her back and feet was the untouchable visage at the very forefront that many locked their eyes to.

She had reached further than anyone else as she currently floated off the barren earth in front of billowing gray mist that seemed to rise up as an enormous wall that blocked the way forward- the area past this wall still being hidden as everything behind it was what became visible!

In this now visible area, one could see powerful Will Bearer groups and Obsidian Adjudicator Commanders with a few strongest members from their Legions, as well as the renowned figures of genius Limit Breakers from the Main Reality!
Juliette.
The Young Emperor.
Aegon.
Ezekiel.

Beings with astounding destiny began to be visible to the eyes of all as before these Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses could group up to discern this unique Grotto Sanctum and the words of <Heart of Destiny> they just heard, a particularly shocked and angry voice echoed out that drew in the wills of many.
"What the hell are you doing?!"
OOOOM!
The source was a vibrantly shining Dragon Phoenix with gold and black flaming scales, being part of the Dragon Phoenixes that followed Aegon.

His words drew in the attention of many as the wills of geniuses from the Astral, Dragon Phoenix, Reality Ursidae, Infinite Willow Tree, and Royal Human Bloodlines all turned their sight and wills toward the direction this existence was shouting to.
The eyes of many constricted as there, with all the freedom and grandeur...two beings could be seen calmly sitting in front of the horns of the skull of a regal Dragon Phoenix.
A silver-dressed woman with white silver hair whose eyes shone of mysteries and were currently staring towards another location as she utterly ignored the booming words directed towards them.

And a devilishly handsome Royal Human adorned in simple obsidian pants and a loose shirt that showed off his tout muscles, his dark flowing hair shining with a sense of majesty as he gazed coldly at the shouting genius miles ahead while he used another Dragon Phoenix as a mount!

The Dimensional Royalty who couldn't be easily swayed actually held a hint of shock when she read the information cascading down, but the situation was rapidly changing as the restrictions of vision were gradually lifted in the surroundings- with one being able to see everything nearby with ease as the gray mist was shaken by the rays of golden light.
Barren Lands filled with dead vegetation could be seen, blue ice lining up the areas further inward as the gray mist was still being dissipated there- and at a much slower pace than that.
But with the lifting of the gray veil, those who had climbed up the Chains of Reality could begin to sew those that had managed to climb in this region!
Some time had passed since the first sets of beings appeared on these lands, but many more had arrived since then as the number of Primordials that had appeared here wasn't small.

Whether through relying on the power of others or spending their TABOO authority and Essence of Reality to withstand the restrictions, they slowly appeared here as the truly weak geniuses were all weeded out!
What remained were the strongest of the strong- the geniuses who had all formed TABOO Edicts and had astounding destinies!
The generation of Emperors who would reign in the future to come.
Now, these geniuses could gaze at each other once more as when the surroundings cleared, many of their eyes lit up as they saw those they knew of or were familiar with.
The dazzling figure of Akaris adorned with pairs of wings on her back and feet was the untouchable visage at the very forefront that many locked their eyes to.

She had reached further than anyone else as she currently floated off the barren earth in front of billowing gray mist that seemed to rise up as an enormous wall that blocked the way forward- the area past this wall still being hidden as everything behind it was what became visible!

In this now visible area, one could see powerful Will Bearer groups and Obsidian Adjudicator Commanders with a few strongest members from their Legions, as well as the renowned figures of genius Limit Breakers from the Main Reality!
Juliette.
The Young Emperor.
Aegon.
Ezekiel.

Beings with astounding destiny began to be visible to the eyes of all as before these Pure-Blooded Primordial Geniuses could group up to discern this unique Grotto Sanctum and the words of <Heart of Destiny> they just heard, a particularly shocked and angry voice echoed out that drew in the wills of many.
"What the hell are you doing?!"
OOOOM!
The source was a vibrantly shining Dragon Phoenix with gold and black flaming scales, being part of the Dragon Phoenixes that followed Aegon.

His words drew in the attention of many as the wills of geniuses from the Astral, Dragon Phoenix, Reality Ursidae, Infinite Willow Tree, and Royal Human Bloodlines all turned their sight and wills toward the direction this existence was shouting to.
The eyes of many constricted as there, with all the freedom and grandeur...two beings could be seen calmly sitting in front of the horns of the skull of a regal Dragon Phoenix.
A silver-dressed woman with white silver hair whose eyes shone of mysteries and were currently staring towards another location as she utterly ignored the booming words directed towards them.

And a devilishly handsome Royal Human adorned in simple obsidian pants and a loose shirt that showed off his tout muscles, his dark flowing hair shining with a sense of majesty as he gazed coldly at the shouting genius miles ahead while he used another Dragon Phoenix as a mount!

chapters.title: Chapter 1838
paragraphs: The eyes of the True geniuses that had managed to reach these lands constricted when they gazed at the unique scene right in front of a Chain of Reality and the glacial sea region behind it.
A scene of a magnificent Dragon Phoenix with a solidified crown swirling with the ecritures of <VAS> being used as a mount for two beings!
What was worse was that the prestige of this Dragon Phoenix was known- this existence being Andur of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality!
Thus, an existence had shouted what the two beings were doing.
To dare to look down on the dignity of the Dragon Phoenixes like this!
It was also a question to Andur himself- as for what someone distinguished like him was doing allowing others to sit atop him!
The air condensed at this moment as time moved utterly slow in the eyes of many.

A bit less than half of all Pure-Blooded Primordials who had managed to reach this region were uniquely those who had chosen to break onto the Primogenial Strata and become LEGENDS in order to attain more treasures.
The one who had spoken...was a genius at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy who depended on the group around Emperor Aegon to ascend.
He wasn't even a Limit Breaker!
OOOM!
'Yet...you dared to admonish me in such a way?'
Noah's thoughts buzzed as the tyranny at the depths of his Soul bubbled.
He had broken his Limits in all the Aspects of Existence as only other Limit Breakers could even imagine disturbing a hair on his body!
Only LEGENDS could possibly injure him!
So how could an existence that had merely forged a TABOO Edict after millions of years so comfortable as to shout in admonishment towards him?
'No.'
WAA!
This had to change.
The grandeur of the Tyrannical Emperor had to be established in order for random minor characters to not dare to raise their voices towards him like so!

This sense of tyranny that had been budding within Noah's Bloodline this while time erupted at this moment as under the gazes of all beings, an illusory authority of a single Black Ascendancy Halo flashed while he was still sitting down atop his mount, the glorious allure of Sever rushing out at speeds that only a few beings managed to see as in instant...
ZAP!

The enraged and astonished existence that had spoken felt his Origin rocked by an undeniable light as his Body and Soul were extinguished right after- his entire body turning into a poof of golden bloody light as even the hard bones of a Dragon Phoenix were pulverized!
Shock flashed through the eyes of all these True Geniuses as nobody spoke for the next two seconds!

The visage of the powerful Dragon Phoenix that was Emperor Aegon vibrated with power as his majestic scales shone with a powerful sheen- having one of his people eradicated right before his eyes as the attack was too fast for him to even intervene.
Yet he didn't erupt as like many of the True Geniuses here, he was learned in Destiny and had lived for many millions of years.
Seeing the two existences sitting above Andur and even the power that Noah had just displayed, all beings here knew that he was someone powerful!
Someone that might even reach the Tiers of leading Emperors like Aegon, the Young Emperor, or even someone as astounding as Juliette.
Before they fully ascertained this, none of them would be too rash!
Yet even with all this, there was still the dignity of the Dragon Phoenix Bloodline.
Seeing one of their own turned into a mount before their eyes was unacceptable, and seeing another turned into a mist of blood was even more dreadful!
"You dared."
HUUM!
Emperor Aegon was the one to speak next as 30 dazzling Ascendancy Halos flashed around him.
Noah looked at this creature that he quickly discerned to be a Limit Breaker at the Ninth Firmament of Ascendancy with an astounding foundation as he spoke coldly with an air of unbound tyranny.
"A fool dared to disrespect my authority and speak in such a tone. He naturally had to pay the price."
The mood turned heavy.
The meaning resounded in the minds of many!
The price for disrespecting this being's authority was death!

The eyes of the genius Infinite Willow Trees, Astral beings, Reality Ursidae, Dragon Phoenixes, and even the Royal Humans turned sharp at this scene as Emperor Aegon contained his bubbling power and spoke with utmost majesty.

"You are Alexander King, a follower of a Candidate Bloodline Emperor of the Royal Humans in the Pure-Blooded Domains. Yet the being you are standing atop of is of the Imperial Dragon Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality!"
WAA!
"The genius you just killed is of the Golden Phoenix Lineage of the Main Reality!"
Yes!
These were beings who were distinguished and had purpose.
One could not just do what this Alexander was doing now, even if they themselves were from the Main Reality!
Not to mention the wills of all the surrounding geniuses knowing that he was supposedly only a Follower of a Candidate Bloodline Emperor.
Yet towards all of these assertions, Noah actually patted the purple gold scales of Andur who hadn't spoken a word as he said...
"So what?"
Waves of destiny and tyranny rose as it became clear to all what the nature of this being was!
They felt boundless tyranny!
True and unfettered tyranny that didn't even put the distinguished geniuses of the Bloodlines from the Main Reality in his eyes!
As things became eerily quiet and Emperor Aegon seemed ready to erupt...
"Haha, well said!"
BZZT!
From a different direction, the visage of the genius of the Pure-Blooded Astral Bloodline- Juliette, appeared as she laughed boisterously.
Her astral stellar form was magnetic to see as surging flames surrounded her figure, Helen following behind her while looking at Noah with a careful look!

"So what if they are from distinguished Lineages from the Main Reality? If they went against the authority of another and were subjugated or killed...it just means their destiny and strength weren't up to par."

The voice of Juliette rang out in the minds of all as things became somewhat difficult to navigate, Noah turning towards this vivacious Astral Genius who while in the middle of everyone here spoke out ridiculous words while her blessed astral chest shone with splendor.
"You are interesting! How about a spar? If you win against this big sister here, you can have me as another one of your spoils!"
